annotations.title: Start a studio session for a song

description: Returns a 15-minute ticket for one of the person's songs, which the studio in the chat uses to upload stems, show the label check and the progress, and play the original, the mix and the master. The studio calls this tool on its own; the assistant does not need to call it directly.

songId.description: The song id from list_songs or create_song.

name: get_song_session
